chapters.chapterName: Early Rome & the Kingdom: The Foundation of an Empire (753-509 BCE)

battle.name: Lake Regillus
battle.intro: The exiled Tarquin has not given up. An alliance of Latin towns marches on Rome, and the armies meet at Lake Regillus. Win, and the young Republic survives.

chapters.chapterName: Early Republic: The Conflict of the Orders - Origins (509-450 BCE)

battle.name: War with the Volsci
battle.intro: Rome is at war with three neighbours: the Sabines, and the Aequi and Volsci, hill tribes to the east and south-east. The plebeians are back from the Sacred Mount, with tribunes of their own. Now Rome needs every soldier.

chapters.chapterName: Early Republic: The Conflict of the Orders - Toward Resolution (450-367 BCE)

battle.name: The Fall of Veii
battle.intro: Veii, a great Etruscan city just 16 km from Rome, has held out for years. Camillus, named dictator, has a plan: a tunnel through the soft rock beneath the walls.

chapters.chapterName: Early Republic: The Samnite Wars (367-290 BCE)

battle.name: Aquilonia
battle.intro: Some 40,000 Samnites gather at Aquilonia. Their elite units have sworn a sacred oath never to flee. The consul Papirius Cursor attacks.

chapters.chapterName: Early Republic: Final Conquest of Italy (290-264 BCE)

battle.name: Beneventum
battle.intro: Pyrrhus, the Greek king who has beaten Rome twice at a terrible cost, faces the Romans one last time at Beneventum. Ancient accounts disagree on how it ended. Today, the outcome is up to you.
